supercharger_access.notes: Canadian article (2024-09-18): Canadian Blazer EV, Equinox EV, Silverado EV and LYRIQ owners can buy the GM NACS adapter for Tesla Superchargers. Current state for model year 2026: adapter needed. Markets: CA/US. (2026 car: same port and adapter state as the 2025 car on this model.)
Estimated: same CCS1 car and GM adapter programme as the 2025 Blazer EV tested by InsideEVs (US). Model year 2026.

charge_port.notes: Estimated: GCN (GM 2027 NACS announcement) says most 2026 GM EVs keep CCS1 and need the GM NACS adapter, naming only the Optiq and Bolt as NACS-native for 2026; Blazer EV is not one of them. Model year 2026. Canadian car assumed the same (Guide Auto 2024-09-18: Canadian owners need the GM adapter).
